staged.metadataKind: data-only JSON (not a JS module, so the unreachable-module inventory is unaffected)

headers.Authorization: DefaultExecutor auth descriptor for nous-research (Bearer <selected connection apiKey>); staged executor refuses to send without a well-formed apiKey

request.body: OpenAI Chat Completions; model is the upstream id (one leading 'nous/' and any '(level)' suffix removed)

thinking.enabled: reasoning: { enabled: true, effort } with effort clamped to low|medium|high; auto/adaptive/unknown -> medium; budget -> budgetToLevel then clamp

request.credentialHandling: Selected connection credentials only; NousExecutor.execute drops credentials.runtimeTransport (baseUrl, urlSuffix, headers, auth, format) before the inherited Base/DefaultExecutor path without modifying the caller's object, so the endpoint stays https://inference-api.nousresearch.com/v1/chat/completions and OpenAI wire handling (tool is_error normalization) always applies; providerSpecificData.baseUrl ignored; redirect:'error' via BaseExecutor credentialed send; selected connection proxyOptions via proxyAwareFetch; existing attribution tags kept

models.catalogRequest: GET, no Authorization (public endpoint), Accept: application/json, redirect:'error', 10s timeout, 4 MiB bounded read, selected connection proxy
models.catalogParsing: data|models|results|array; non-object, id-less, duplicate and non-text (embedding/image-only) entries dropped; nousresearch/ first, stable order; routed ids 'nous/<id>' with upstreamModelId
models.freeFilter: explicit zero prompt+completion price only (number 0 or decimal zero string after trim); null, blank, boolean, array, object, NaN, hex and negative-zero strings fail closed; text output; context >= 200000

usage.perRequest: OpenAI-compatible usage object returned unchanged by the executor

probe.localChecks: string, trimmed, 1..4096 visible ASCII characters, no whitespace
probe.invalidKeys: rejected before persist; persist never called
